profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company, traded under the ticker MU, headquartered in Boise, Idaho, with SEC CIK 0000723125. On its own website it describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions.

The site material is mostly product and design support rather than named products. It offers data sheets that can be searched, filtered and downloaded, design tools and technical documentation, sales support, and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples. It also points to a Technology Enablement Program (TEP). The company says mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies that enable predictive, insightful and new experiences for end users. No individual product names appear in the available text.

The litigation record associated with the company lists 20 cases in Idaho. No lawsuits are listed in the cases field, and no MCP servers are recorded.
